steps.why: The game unpacks its data to /sdcard/OpenArenaVR on the first start. The guide has the user allow file access.

steps.text: Open OpenArena-VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. The first start unpacks the game data, which takes about a minute.

notes: Game data is inside the APK (about 400 MB). freeSpaceMB is the guide's figure; the unpacked copy may need as much again. The .sha256 asset is avoided.
